section: S6 record edits and iPhone engine
title: Carry the engine's refusal reason on ApplyResult (with I-2's later steps, once the generated contract types the edit results; not before)
evidence: The engine sends reason (ios/engine/cloud.ts:252 refuse erased) and Swift decodes it (EditOutcome.reason, ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/MyData.swift:376), but RecordStore drops it building ApplyResult.refused (RecordStore.swift:14-18 has message and existingId only; :402 and RecordStore+Source.swift:167). Onboarding decides by state instead (PR 1570)
